# google_apigee_custom_report

A custom report definition for Apigee Analytics. Custom reports allow you
to drill into API metrics and dimensions to understand API performance
and usage patterns. Reports are scoped to an Apigee organization.


To get more information about CustomReport, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/apigee/docs/reference/apis/apigee/rest/v1/organizations.reports)
* How-to Guides
    * [Creating a custom report](https://cloud.google.com/apigee/docs/api-platform/analytics/create-custom-reports)

## Example Usage - Apigee Custom Report Basic


```hcl
data "google_client_config" "current" {}

resource "google_compute_network" "apigee_network" {
  name = "apigee-network"
}

resource "google_compute_global_address" "apigee_range" {
  name          = "apigee-range"
  purpose       = "VPC_PEERING"
  address_type  = "INTERNAL"
  prefix_length = 16
  network       = google_compute_network.apigee_network.id
}

resource "google_service_networking_connection" "apigee_vpc_connection" {
  network                 = google_compute_network.apigee_network.id
  service                 = "servicenetworking.googleapis.com"
  reserved_peering_ranges = [google_compute_global_address.apigee_range.name]
}

resource "google_apigee_organization" "apigee_org" {
  analytics_region   = "us-central1"
  project_id         = data.google_client_config.current.project
  authorized_network = google_compute_network.apigee_network.id
  depends_on         = [google_service_networking_connection.apigee_vpc_connection]
}

resource "google_apigee_custom_report" "apigee_custom_report" {
  org_id       = google_apigee_organization.apigee_org.id
  display_name = "my_custom_report"

  metrics {
    name     = "message_count"
    function = "sum"
  }

  dimensions = ["apiproxy"]
}
```
## Example Usage - Apigee Custom Report Full


```hcl
data "google_client_config" "current" {}

resource "google_compute_network" "apigee_network" {
  name = "apigee-network"
}

resource "google_compute_global_address" "apigee_range" {
  name          = "apigee-range"
  purpose       = "VPC_PEERING"
  address_type  = "INTERNAL"
  prefix_length = 16
  network       = google_compute_network.apigee_network.id
}

resource "google_service_networking_connection" "apigee_vpc_connection" {
  network                 = google_compute_network.apigee_network.id
  service                 = "servicenetworking.googleapis.com"
  reserved_peering_ranges = [google_compute_global_address.apigee_range.name]
}

resource "google_apigee_organization" "apigee_org" {
  analytics_region   = "us-central1"
  project_id         = data.google_client_config.current.project
  authorized_network = google_compute_network.apigee_network.id
  depends_on         = [google_service_networking_connection.apigee_vpc_connection]
}

resource "google_apigee_custom_report" "apigee_custom_report" {
  org_id       = google_apigee_organization.apigee_org.id
  display_name = "my_detailed_report"

  metrics {
    name     = "message_count"
    function = "sum"
  }

  metrics {
    name     = "total_response_time"
    function = "avg"
  }

  dimensions   = ["apiproxy", "request_verb"]
  filter       = "(apiproxy eq 'my-proxy')"
  time_unit    = "hour"
  sort_by_cols = ["message_count"]
  sort_order   = "DESC"
  chart_type   = "line"
  tags         = ["production", "analytics"]

  properties {
    property = "ui.chart.showTotal"
    value {
      name  = "showTotal"
      value = "true"
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `display_name` -
  (Required)
  The display name for the custom report.

* `metrics` -
  (Required)
  The metrics to include in the custom report. Each metric specifies
  a name and an optional aggregation function.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_metrics).

* `org_id` -
  (Required)
  The Apigee Organization associated with the Apigee custom report,
  in the format `organizations/{{org_name}}`.


* `dimensions` -
  (Optional)
  The dimensions to group the report by. For example, `apiproxy` or `target_host`.

* `filter` -
  (Optional)
  A filter expression to apply to the report data. For example,
  `(apiproxy eq 'my-proxy')`.

* `time_unit` -
  (Optional)
  The time unit for aggregating report data. Valid values include
  `minute`, `hour`, `day`, `week`, and `month`.

* `sort_by_cols` -
  (Optional)
  The columns to sort the report results by.

* `sort_order` -
  (Optional)
  The sort order for the report results. For example, `ASC` or `DESC`.

* `chart_type` -
  (Optional)
  The chart type for displaying the report. For example, `line` or `column`.

* `tags` -
  (Optional)
  Tags associated with the custom report.

* `properties` -
  (Optional)
  Key-value properties associated with the report.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_properties).

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_metrics"></a>The `metrics` block supports:

* `name` -
  (Required)
  The name of the metric. For example, `message_count` or `total_response_time`.

* `function` -
  (Optional)
  The aggregation function to apply to the metric.
  Common values include `avg`, `min`, `max`, `sum`, and `rate`.

<a name="nested_properties"></a>The `properties` block supports:

* `property` -
  (Optional)
  The property name.

* `value` -
  (Optional)
  The property values. Each value is an Attribute object with a name and value.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_properties_value).


<a name="nested_properties_value"></a>The `value` block supports:

* `name` -
  (Optional)
  The attribute name.

* `value` -
  (Optional)
  The attribute value.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `{{org_id}}/reports/{{name}}`

* `name` -
  The internal resource name of the custom report, a UUID assigned
  by the server on creation. Used as the identifier in the API URL path.

* `organization` -
  The Apigee organization name.

* `environment` -
  The Apigee environment name.

* `created_at` -
  The time at which the custom report was created in milliseconds since the epoch.

* `last_modified_at` -
  The time at which the custom report was last modified in milliseconds since the epoch.

* `last_viewed_at` -
  The time at which the custom report was last viewed in milliseconds since the epoch.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 1 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 1 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 1 minutes.

## Import


CustomReport can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `{{org_id}}/reports/{{name}}`
* `{{org_id}}/{{name}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/identities) to import CustomReport using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    name = "<-optional value->"
    orgId = "<-required value->"
  }
  to = google_apigee_custom_report.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import CustomReport using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "{{org_id}}/reports/{{name}}"
  to = google_apigee_custom_report.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), CustomReport can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_apigee_custom_report.default {{org_id}}/reports/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_apigee_custom_report.default {{org_id}}/{{name}}
```
